vetSays.line: 🛡️ the person in their 60s, with a gap-toothed grin, Ray, Nena and Carlos met them at the door — 4 put down. the person in their 60s, with a gap-toothed grin, Ray, Nena, Carlos are hurt.
🛡️ Mario, Abigail and Ray met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off. Mario, Abigail, Ray are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Abigail, Ray and Nena met them at the door — 3 put down. Abigail, Ray, Nena are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Abigail just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nena just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Abigail, Ray, Nena and Quinn met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Abigail, Ray, Quinn are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Quinn just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Oliver just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Ray, Nena, Quinn, Tariq and Oliver met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Ray, Nena, Quinn, Tariq, Oliver are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carlos just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Diana taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Diana passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
🛡️ Dwayne, Enrique and Jorge met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Dwayne, Enrique, Jorge are hurt.
🛡️ Dwayne, Enrique, Jorge and Nino met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 barely walked away. Dwayne, Enrique, Jorge, Nino are hurt.
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Enrique just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jorge just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Enrique, Jorge and Nino met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Enrique, Nino are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Enrique just put down The Eater... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Enrique, Jorge, Valeria and Nikos met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Enrique, Jorge, Valeria, Nikos are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
🛡️ Enrique and Temitope met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Enrique, Temitope are hurt.
